help.title: About Shipping Zones
help.overview: Checkout offers every rate from active zones that match the destination. The shopper picks one. A zone needs a name and at least one rate. A zone with no countries does not match.

sections.title: How a destination matches
sections.body: Country must be one of the zone countries. State and postal code narrow it further.
items: If you list states, the destination state must be one of them. Leave states empty to match the whole country.
Postal patterns are optional. An empty list matches every postal code. Use * as a wildcard, for example 10*.
Without a destination country, no rates are offered.

sections.title: How a rate is priced
sections.body: Each matching rate is listed with its name, price, carrier, and estimated days. Carrier and days do not change the price.
items: Flat charges its price. Free charges 0, and is hidden when the order amount is outside its minimum or maximum.
Weight uses the cart weight and is hidden outside its weight window. Price uses the merchandise subtotal and its order-amount window.
Quantity compares the item count with the minimum and maximum order-amount fields, not the money total.
A free-shipping discount waives the shipping charge at checkout. It does not remove the rates from this list.
